name: Orange Grove RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 26.6651,-81.8173: RV and park-model rows on a grid inside a residential block, no water body adjoining or in view of any site - not waterfront

name: Lakes RV
evidence: satellite (Esri, 180 m frame) at 26.5290,-81.8736: the park's west edge runs along a Lakes Regional Park lake arm; the south-end loop's pads sit on open, unused grass ~20-25 m from the shoreline with no treeline or road between (the middle of the west row is screened by a dense palm/mangrove band). Operator sells 'waterfront sites directly on the lake' - consistent - lakefront

name: Seminole Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 26.7205,-81.8109: RV loops under oak/pine canopy; Popash Creek runs through the woods and can't be seen at any pad; the lake to the west is beyond the park's treeline and a track - not waterfront (canopy-blind, defaults down)

name: Gulf Waters RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 26.4910,-81.9372: two interior retention ponds; the south pond (~1.5 ha) is ringed by RV sites on open lawn with ~5-15 m to the water and no road between - the operator's 'Lux Lakefront' tier - pond

name: Encore Gulf Air RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 26.4899,-81.9430: RV grid between San Carlos Blvd and vacant land, no water adjoining or in view of the sites - not waterfront

name: Encore Tranquility Lakes RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 1 km frame) at 26.7383,-82.0409: rows of RV pads wrap the shore of a large (~600 m) lake on open lawn a few metres from the water with no road or treeline between - lakefront

name: Sugar Sand Beach RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 26.6304,-82.0684: the RV pads sit on an open sand/shell lot at the seawalled point on Matlacha Pass, within ~10-30 m of the water with nothing between - bayfront

name: Bonita Lake RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 240 m and 1.4 km frames) at 26.3563,-81.7820: the park's northwest row faces a ~25 m canal across the park road, and the northeast loop faces a small pond across the same road - water visible across open ground, but a road between - view, not on-water - lakeview

name: Imperial Bonita Estates
evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m and 300 m frames) at 26.3375,-81.7582: the RV section sits in the middle of the co-op; its south row backs onto dense oak canopy hiding the Imperial River - the 'river lots' the operator sells can't be confirmed on-water or in view under the canopy - not waterfront (defaults down)

name: Sanctuary RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 26.3324,-81.7285: paved RV loops between Bonita Beach Rd and woods; the lake to the east is behind a continuous treeline - not waterfront
